detail.longDescription: Need a reminder without installing extra software? Windows 11's built-in Clock app can store as many alarms as you like and still ring them when the app is closed. Here's how to set one up from Start > Clock > Alarm: https:// geekrewind.com/how-to-set-an-a larm-in-windows-11/ # Windows11 # Windows # Tech # Productivity # HowTo
